title: Terminal engine-observation verifier hashes checkout line endings

source_observation.environment: Windows StaticOnly calibration on dev d7c7d23d after MIR3-TERM-0007 with exact frozen terminal evidence
source_observation.fact: The terminal engine-observation verifier compared canonical LF observer-tool bindings to physical CRLF checkout hashes and rejected unchanged Git content.

reproducer.expected: Observer and normalizer script bindings use the shared canonical UTF-8/NFC/LF/final-newline identity on both LF and CRLF checkouts while engine executables and frozen ZIPs retain exact physical-byte verification.
reproducer.observed: 1.3.5 stored observer SHA-256 51B0DE097E5ABB166CBAADB05CB9E9D1953C61222DC1F238223D42615BEE2226 and normalizer SHA-256 0D4000E07266D56E4600D6C53B0611A034B819E6FCE467368E55F5271B2C7E87 matched canonical content but differed from physical CRLF hashes D1A7AD201DF449BDE4BA8AB41F5FDC9A3CAF80F7DE88631DDE9ED18EB30BBD71 and 8C26456E384BB7D21E2599C14B3A5E0EFEF919E34AA662D07E933A1A42DC46C5.
